# NoteInput

Used directly by: [`createPersonNote`](../operations/createPersonNote.md)

A note to create on a person.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` * | string | The body of the note. Required and non-empty — absent, null and empty all return 400. The API's own stated limit is 8000 characters, and 8001 is rejected with 400, but anything from 7001 to 8000 characters returns 500 without saving. 7000 is the longest text that actually works, which is what this schema allows. e.g. `Great chat! This person will be able to volunteer next year.` |
| `isViewRestricted` | boolean | Restricts the note to certain users in the context. A note saved with true is accepted (204) but then invisible to API keys — it never comes back from GET /people/{vanId}/notes, so it cannot be read, updated or verified through the API afterwards. |
| `category` | object | The category to file a note under. |
| `category.noteCategoryId` * | integer (int32) | Id of a category from GET /notes/categories whose `assignableTypes` contain `Person`. An id outside that set returns 400 INVALID_PARAMETER. `noteCategoryId: 0` — the value the API itself reports for an uncategorized note — returns 500, so omit `category` entirely instead of sending zero. e.g. `24` |
| `contactHistory` | object | A Contact History record to create alongside the note. It does not come back on the note afterwards — the note's own `contactHistory` stays null in every response. |
| `contactHistory.contactTypeId` | string | A Contact Type id from GET /canvassResponses/contactTypes. An id outside that list returns 400. If an `inputTypeId` is also given, the contact type must be available to it. e.g. `1` |
| `contactHistory.inputTypeId` | string | An Input Type id from GET /canvassResponses/inputTypes. Defaults to 11 (API). e.g. `11` |
| `contactHistory.dateCanvassed` | string (date-time) | ISO 8601 timestamp of the contact attempt. Defaults to today. e.g. `2026-08-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `contactHistory.resultCodeId` | string | A Result Code id from GET /canvassResponses/resultCodes. Defaults to Canvassed. An id outside that list returns 500 rather than the 400 an invalid contactTypeId gets. e.g. `14` |
| `isPinned` | boolean | Accepted and ignored — the created note always reads back `isPinned: false`. Included here only because the API tolerates it. |

`*` = required.
